title: Anthony S Possible NDE 6257
content: I was a healthy child and I slept normally. But at a certain time during the night, I `woke up' and found myself floating about two feet from the ceiling, I felt as though I was on my back and in this position gently floated out of the bedroom, along the landing, down the stairs, along the hallway, and into the dining room at the back of the house. In the dining room apparently superimposed on the curtained off French windows was a disc of golden light, although bright it was not dazzling. It was about four or five feet in diameter, and I was gently, slowly, moving towards it. At a certain time, I realized that the light was drawing me to it, and that I had no control over it. I grew apprehensive, then frightened, and still I was drawn towards the light. I then became panic stricken, and then woke up in my bed, still scared stiff. During this experience, I was wide-awake and fully alert although I was out of my body. It was not a dream. If it had been a dream, I would have forgotten it by now. It is still clearly etched in my memory. A young lady to whom I related this event said something that I had never considered before she said, 'You know, that night you nearly died'. I think she meant that had I been drawn into the light, been absorbed by it, and that I would have died. She said that I would have been fully enlightened and would have had no need to have returned to the physical world. After much consideration during my life I have come to the conclusion that this was NEARLY a death event.

environment.environment_other_detail: A disc of golden light, about four or five feet in diameter, was apparently superimposed on curtained French windows in the dining room; bright but not dazzling.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with movement through the house toward a disc of golden light; no tunnel, no life review, no beings; abrupt return to bed upon panic.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred during sleep as a child; the light appeared as a disc superimposed on curtained French windows; the experiencer interpreted it as 'nearly' a death event rather than an actual near-death medical crisis.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I `woke up' and found myself floating about two feet from the ceiling...”; “...a disc of golden light, although bright it was not dazzling.”; “During this experience, I was wide-awake and fully alert although I was out of my body. It was not a dream.”; “It is still clearly etched in my memory.”; “...I have come to the conclusion that this was NEARLY a death event.”
